issues: A debug title CONFETTI CROSSFIRE sat on top; the subject was a 168px number inside a 640px white card, leaving the frame empty and weightless
Pale gray backdrop with amber/gray confetti — the palette had nothing to do with the picture and read as neither brand nor celebration
Every piece was the same rectangle, flipping only by squashing scaleY; no streamers, no shape variety
Reveal and cannon fire landed on the same frame, the number merely scaled in, and the tail was a static white card
changes: Look switched to sand (warm paper stage, terracotta, indigo accent) and rebuilt as a guest-rating poster: eyebrow, a 380px 4.97 with a muted /5, five stars, a subtitle
Rhythm now fires ahead of the beat: 4 · . · 9 · 7 rise from a mask 4f apart, left cannon at f22 and right at f24 while the last digit is still rising; the number takes a 1→1.03→1 kick

Confetti upgraded: 72 pieces per cannon in three shapes (strips, squares, dots) plus 2 arc-length-capped serpentine streamers; true perspective rotate3d flips with darker backs, velocity stretch at launch, flutter after apex
Three depth layers: small blurred pieces behind the number, 1.85× defocused pieces sweeping past the lens; colors come strictly from the same look
Follow-through: stars pop in one by one (the last fills only 97%), subtitle rises word by word; confetti clears by ~f132, then ≥44f of clean poster with a 1.5% slow push; 150→176f
